_comment: A cooldown that raises a timed self-buff; while active, a share of any incoming hit, measured before your own mitigation, is reflected back with the damage tag authored here, not the attacker's own. Level increases the share only; the window stays flat. It stacks with FireShield as two separate hits rather than one summed hit. All values placeholder.
name: Retribution
description: The share is of the hit as thrown, before your own mitigation.
